basics.name: Benjamin Buettner
basics.label: Applied Economist, IP, Innovation Research and Data Science
basics.summary: I analyze how public science translates into innovation using IP data, machine learning, and econometrics. My work focuses on disclosure, diffusion barriers, and the societal and economic impact.

work.name: Eindhoven University of Technology
work.summary: Developed scalable methods to identify patent–paper pairs using deep learning applied to text, figures, and metadata from patents and scientific articles.
highlights: Trained neural networks for image- and text-based similarity
Built scalable pipelines to detect direct links between research and innovation
Constructed and shared datasets for use by the broader research community

work.name: Eindhoven University of Technology
work.summary: Studied how diffusion barriers affect the reuse of scientific knowledge using patent data, machine learning, and econometrics.
highlights: Analyzed machine translation effects on cross-border citation flows
Linked patent data to H-1B visa records to study talent flows
Used image recognition to detect overlap between paywalled articles and patents

work.name: Jiangsu University of Technology
work.summary: Managed international academic team; taught cultural, sociological, and linguistic topics; German language instruction.

work.name: Sophia University
work.summary: Part of research team evaluating western waste management concepts in East Asia.
highlights: Performed statistical evaluation using R and Python

work.name: Siemens AG
work.summary: Assisted divisions worldwide on export compliance; analyzed data using Excel, VBA, and Access.

publications.name: Patents and knowledge diffusion: the impact of machine translation
publications.summary: Examines how machine translation affects knowledge diffusion across borders using patent citation data.

publications.name: Deriving experience curves: a structured and critical approach applied to PV sector
publications.summary: Develops a structured methodology to derive experience curves in the photovoltaics sector.

publications.name: Patent Disclosure and Migration
publications.summary: Explores the role of examiners in signaling talent and knowledge transfer, using patent citation and visa data.

publications.name: Unveiling Hidden Connections Between Science and Innovation
publications.summary: Proposes a novel method to detect patent–paper pairs using deep learning.

publications.name: Breaking the Paywall: Patents as Channels for Scientific Disclosure
publications.summary: Investigates whether patents can substitute for access to closed-access publications.
